instruction: Help me create a desktop shortcut for this online learning platform using Chrome's shortcut maker.

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to create a desktop shortcut for Khan Academy using Chrome's built-in shortcut feature. The evaluator checks for a .desktop file with the correct Exec line containing the app-id for Khan Academy.
metadata.verification: Reused existing is_shortcut_on_desktop metric and shortcuts_on_desktop getter. The expected exec path includes the Chrome-generated app-id.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic (shortcuts_on_desktop at chrome.py:1084-1116) correctly extracts .desktop shortcut files from the desktop directory and reads their contents into a dictionary
Metric logic (is_shortcut_on_desktop at chrome.py:487-507) correctly performs exact string matching for the Exec line: checks if 'Exec=' + rule['exec'] + '\n' exists in any shortcut content

Expected exec value is semantically correct: /opt/google/chrome/google-chrome --profile-directory=Default --app-id=mjhigedjldjldbidpaokdemkpicnngbe uses the proper Chrome PWA (Progressive Web App) format for Khan Academy
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the sole requirement - that a desktop shortcut with the correct Chrome app launch command exists
State accessibility: getter reads persistent .desktop files from filesystem, which remain after task completion (no transient UI state dependency)
No postconfig needed: Unlike dialog-based tasks, desktop shortcuts are persistent files that don't require reopening any UI to verify

Minor limitation: Chrome app-ids are typically stable for a given website but can theoretically vary across different Chrome profiles or installations. The provided app-id (mjhigedjldjldbidpaokdemkpicnngbe) appears to be the standard Khan Academy PWA ID, but this may need empirical verification across test environments.
